channel.title: PAGASA VISPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:52 AM 20 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Guimaras(Jordan, Sibunag and NuevaValencia) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:15 AM 20 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Brooke'sPoint, SofronioEspanola, Narra, Aborlan and PuertoPrincesaCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Balabac and Bataraza) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 20 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #Palawan, #OccidentalMindoro, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #NegrosOriental, #NegrosOccidental, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
